semantics: Combinational one-hot incoming-transition equations; Moore outputs depend only on active state bits. State index 0..9 maps S,S1,S11,S110,B0,B1,B2,B3,Count,Wait.
reset: No clock/reset ports or state storage; upstream reset selects state[0].
ambiguities: Illegal zero/multi-hot state is not specified; use direct OR-of-incoming-transition equations, including superposition for multi-hot states.
verification_plan: Exhaust all 1024 state masks and 8 binary inputs using table-based incoming transitions and Moore-output superposition. No official tests.
